commentary.text: 90+8' Jarred Gillett is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
90+5' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
90+5' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. A free kick to Brentford.
90+4' Leeds can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+4' Daniel James (Leeds) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. Leeds win a corner kick.
90+3' Daniel James (Leeds) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+2' Anton Stach (Leeds) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90+1' The game is interrupted now, Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Noah Okafor (Leeds) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Caoimhin Kelleher gets down to his right to keep it out.
88' Good defending. Daniel James (Leeds) tries to find Ao Tanaka inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
86' Daniel James (Leeds) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
84' Handball by Ethan Ampadu (Leeds).
83' Daniel Farke has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel James (Leeds) replacing Pascal Struijk.
82' Igor Thiago (Brentford) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
80' Total attempts – 12:5.
77' Substitution. Kevin Schade walks off the pitch and Dango Ouattara (Brentford) comes on as a substitute.
76' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Leeds.

75' Anton Stach curls the ball into the box from the corner, but Pascal Struijk (Leeds) makes a right mess of a close-range header when under pressure and sends it well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
75' Anton Stach (Leeds) will deliver the corner kick.

75' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Ao Tanaka (Leeds). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Corner kick. Leeds will have an opportunity.
74' Anton Stach (Leeds) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
73' Michael Kayode (Brentford) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The ball has crossed the sideline. Brentford are taking a throw-in.
72' The linesman raises his flag. Jayden Bogle (Leeds) is adjudged offside.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Noah Okafor (Leeds) will replace Lukas Nmecha.
68' Daniel Farke decides to make a substitution. Brenden Aaronson will be replaced by Ao Tanaka (Leeds).
68' The ball is cleared after Igor Thiago (Brentford) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
67' Jordan Henderson (Brentford) swings it in and Kevin Schade gets on the end of it, but Karl Darlow shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
66' Corner kicks – 1:2.
62' Michael Kayode (Brentford) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
61' Kevin Schade (Brentford) picks up a long through ball, but Karl Darlow deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
58' Kevin Schade (Brentford) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is out of play. Leeds will take a throw-in.

56' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Caoimhin Kelleher pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
55' The ball possession at the moment is 56:44.
51' Anton Stach picks out Brenden Aaronson (Leeds), who drives a shot just wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
49' Kevin Schade (Brentford) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
48' Kevin Schade (Brentford) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' Anton Stach (Leeds) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
45+3' Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45+2' The ball is out of play. Brentford will have a throw-in.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
42' Jayden Bogle (Leeds) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
42' James Justin (Leeds) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
41' Jaka Bijol (Leeds) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
38' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
37' Jordan Henderson (Brentford) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
36' Jordan Henderson (Brentford) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the bottom left corner and Caoimhin Kelleher easily makes the save.
34' James Justin (Leeds) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
33' Surely that's handball by one of the Brentford players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
30' A big rebound finds it way to Jayden Bogle (Leeds), whose attempted long-range shot is almost immediately blocked by one of the opposition players.
27' Brentford enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
24' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Leeds.
22' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle and it's Kevin Schade (Brentford) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
20' Igor Thiago (Brentford) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
19' James Justin (Leeds) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
17' Kevin Schade receives a sweet cross inside the box from Igor Thiago (Brentford), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
16' The ball is behind the touchline and Brentford will take a throw-in.
13' Joe Rodon (Leeds) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of James Justin, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
12' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
11' Anton Stach (Leeds) takes the corner but it's cleared.
10' Michael Kayode (Brentford) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
9' Igor Thiago (Brentford) commits a foul and Jarred Gillett immediately signals a free kick.
7' The resulting corner, taken by Mathias Jensen (Brentford), comes to nothing.
5' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
3' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
1' Igor Thiago (Brentford) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Brentford will have the kick-off.
